title: Components the engine keeps or removes by itself (Server/GameKeeps.json in the bridge mod)
description: What GK.Stage.Verify does not count as dirt on a creature, and why: a component the engine creates at a first use and keeps while it holds its default (kept), and one it removes by itself a moment later (passing). docs/contracts/lua-api.md 14.

kept.description: By the component's engine name: how to read it and what it holds when it is not dirt.

lua.description: The component's name as Script Extender reads it on an entity.

empty.description: A list field that is empty when the component holds nothing.

default.description: Fields and the value each holds by default.

any.description: The component holds the game's record of its last request: not dirt whatever it holds.

why.description: Who creates it, when, and what was read to know its default.

passing.description: By the component's engine name: why the engine removes it by itself.
